title: One Block, Multiple Depths: Recurrent Vision Transformers with Depth-Programmed Experts

one_line_essence: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.12448）：reViT（Recurrent Vision Transformers with Depth-Programmed Experts）把 ViT 的'full-depth block 一遍'拉到'single block recurrent + depth-specific FFN as convex combination of shared expert bank + continuous normalized-depth coordinate 程序化'——一个 block 多次复用即可在 inference FLOPs comparable 下匹配 full-depth 精度，无需 intermediate feature distillation。是 multimodal-agent × inference-serving 的 depth-programmed recurrent ViT 长尾架构资产——'depth-as-programmed-trajectory' 范式可迁移到任何 '深度可编程 / FFN-as-mixture / 单 block 复用' 子方向（LLM recurrent depth / 视觉 backbone 压缩 / 边缘部署），与 aiutil 长期关注的 multimodal-agent × inference-serving 主线在'parameter-efficient depth'层面同源。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 expert bank 形式化、跨 ViT size 验证。今日维持长尾卡片。
